review_candidates.title: Hiring, Onboarding & Training Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description MGM Health & Wellness is the London-incorporated management company behind Egypt’s first fully integrated wellness ecosystem. The company leads The Zen Wellness Resort in New Aswan, which combines luxury hospitality with an embedded medical clinic offering multiple specialties. MGM Retreats runs a nationwide wellness roadshow across seven Egyptian destinations, while Juzoor, the farm-to-table dining brand, is expanding nationally from its origins at the resort. MGM Health & Wellness operates at the intersection of wellness tourism, regenerative medicine, and regional wellness investment, with plans for continued expansion across the Middle East and beyond. Team members join a growing organization shaping the future of holistic health, hospitality, and wellness experiences. Role Description The Hiring, Onboarding & Training Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, coordinating interviews, and supporting hiring managers in selection decisions. The manager designs and implements onboarding programs to ensure new team members are integrated effectively into MGM’s wellness ecosystem, culture, and operational standards. They plan and deliver training initiatives for staff across hospitality, clinical, and corporate functions, including orientation, skills development, and performance support. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining HR documentation and policies, tracking hiring and training metrics, collaborating with leadership on workforce planning, and continuously improving talent processes to support the company’s growth and service quality. Qualifications Demonstrated experience in recruitment and hiring processes, including candidate sourcing, interviewing coordination, and collaboration with hiring managers. Proven ability to design, implement, and refine onboarding programs that support employee engagement and rapid integration. Strong background in training design and delivery, such as creating training materials, leading workshops, and evaluating training outcomes. Skills in HR operations, including maintaining employee records, supporting policy implementation, and tracking HR metrics. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders. Solid organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple hiring and training initiatives concurrently. Experience in hospitality, wellness, healthcare, or tourism environments is highly beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proficiency with HR and applicant tracking systems, as well as common office productivity software. Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is a strong advantage for working with local teams and partners.

Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation. You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. If you're passionate about helping customers modernise their analytics stack and leverage AI at scale, we’d love to hear from you! Position Overview The Lead Sales Engineer at Alteryx is a trusted technical advisor who helps large enterprise customers modernise their analytics strategy with AI, automation, and cloud-based data solutions. In this role, you will play the pivotal role of bridging the gap between customer needs and Alteryx’s technical capabilities. This role involves working closely with the go-to-market team to provide technical expertise, product demonstrations, and solution recommendations tailored to prospective clients. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of data analytics, integrating with Cloud Data Warehouses, on-premises to cloud migration journeys, AI, and the evolving tech industry. Works independently with limited supervision. May manage projects/processes. Coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Problems faced are difficult and often complex. Influences others regarding policies, practices and procedures. Primary Responsibilities Lead technical engagements with strategic customers, providing pre-sales support for pre-qualified opportunities and aligning Alteryx solutions with their AI, automation, and cloud analytics strategies. Design and deliver impactful demos and proof-of-concepts (POCs) showcasing the feasibility and value of Alteryx solutions in the customer’s environment, including addressing technical objections and demonstrating how Alteryx provides competitive advantages in cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments Stay ahead of industry trends, including advancements in AI, cloud-native architectures, data governance/security best practices, and how Alteryx integrates with modern cloud data warehouses and AI/ML workflows Remain up to date on Alteryx solutions and features, competitive products, and emerging technologies while maintaining familiarity and adherence to all company methods and procedures. Advise on best practices for AI-driven data automation, cloud cost optimization, and scalable analytics workflows, helping customers accelerate digital transformation. Work with management to drive sales and to mentor junior team members to improve their abilities, skills and knowledge of the Alteryx platform, sales engineering strategies, and client facing skills. Qualifications 6+ years of pre-sales or consultant experience of which at least 3+ in data analytics, business intelligence, or data science, preferably in the software industry. Knowledge of and hands-on experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud data warehousing solutions like Snowflake and Databricks. Certifications with each are a plus. Understanding of SQL, Python, R, Apache Spark or similar product or language are also a plus. Strong knowledge of data analytics, data science, ETL processes, AI/ML workflows, automation, and model deployment within cloud environments. Proficiency in using Alteryx or similar data analytics tools is highly desirable. Experience setting up data connectivity for both on-prem and cloud sources, including ODBC configurations for on-prem systems and OAuth/SSO-based integrations for cloud platforms. Demonstrated ability to handle complex selling situations, including ability to engage with Line of Business Leaders and IT stakeholders, including data scientists, analysts, and C-level executives, to drive change through analytics adoption. Ability to handle a fast-paced environment and continuously re-prioritize while maintaining a constant focus on participating in the sales process. Travel up to 40% or as required. Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. # FP-LI Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Lifebit is powering the world’s federated data platforms for population-scale health and life sciences. Our Federated AI Platform is trusted across national health systems, global pharma, and research biobanks to unlock sensitive biomedical and real-world data securely, compliantly, and at scale. As we scale through our Series B growth phase, we are expanding our product organization to meet the demands of a global market. Join us if you're inspired to tackle meaningful challenges and want to lead the next generation of health technology and cloud-based genomic solutions. The Role As a Data Engineer in our Spain hub, you will bridge the gap between complex biological science and robust software engineering. You will be responsible for building the scalable infrastructure that powers our scientific discoveries, ensuring that our data pipelines are not only high-performing but also strictly compliant with European data protection standards. This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role in our engineering framework — ideal for someone who thrives in complex problem-solving, leads implementations for major features, and mentors others in technical excellence. You’ll work with distributed systems, APIs, and data services that underpin Lifebit’s products — ensuring performance, security, and reliability at scale. Your contributions will directly advance scientific discovery and precision health globally. Your Role and Responsibilities Technical Leadership Architectural Ownership: Lead the implementation of challenging features across distributed architectures, ensuring systems are performant, maintainable, and secure. System Integrity: Design software with built-in resilience and observability; balance immediate product delivery with long-term platform sustainability. Standards Advocate: Champion engineering best practices, including test automation, CI/CD, and high code quality standards. System Design: Proactively identify technical bottlenecks and contribute to cross-team architecture reviews. Delivery Excellence Technical Translation: Convert complex scientific requirements into actionable engineering tasks for the development team. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Product, Science, and DevOps to define milestones and ensure projects move from conception to production with measurable impact. Incident Management: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for live incidents and implement permanent structural solutions. Collaboration & Communication Stakeholder Management: Communicate technical concepts effectively to a diverse audience, ranging from cloud engineers to molecular biologists. Mentorship: Provide guidance and peer feedback to junior and mid-level engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning. Data & Domain Awareness Scientific Alignment: Apply your background in bioinformatics or computational biology to ensure solutions align with genomics or clinical data use cases. Security & Compliance: Build systems that protect sensitive biomedical data, adhering strictly to GDPR (RGPD in Spain), HIPAA, and ISO27001 standards. What You Bring to the Table Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Layers: Expert in designing biomedical knowledge graphs and semantic data models that make implicit relationships in biomedical data explicit and machine-interpretable for LLMs and AI agents to reason over at scale. AI/LLM Infrastructure & Context Engineering: Hands-on experience integrating large language models into data systems, building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) frameworks, and architecting systems where rich metadata, lineage, and business semantics are embedded to enable reliable AI reasoning. Modern Data Fabric Architecture: Proven expertise designing data fabrics and federated data models that connect distributed biomedical data sources (genomics, clinical, imaging, drug discovery) while maintaining provenance, governance, and optimizing for AI/ML workload consumption—not traditional human dashboards. Education: MSc in Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related advanced technical field. Experience: 5+ years in software engineering or computational systems development, preferably in data-heavy or regulated sectors. Tech Stack: Strong programming skills (Python, Go, Java, or similar) and familiarity with microservice or distributed system architectures. Infrastructure: Proven experience designing and maintaining production-grade systems (preferably in data-heavy or regulated environments). Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). Data & Security: Working understanding of data privacy, observability, and security principles. Problem Solving: A pragmatic approach to debugging complex systems and making trade-offs under uncertainty. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with life sciences or healthcare data (e.g., FHIR, OMOP, or VCF). Exposure to federated or privacy-preserving computing systems. Familiarity with data harmonization, metadata catalogs, or scientific workflow orchestration. Experience mentoring engineers or leading code quality initiatives. Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and inclusive approach. What We Offer Benefits Lifebit is synonymous with a dynamic work culture that encourages both personal and professional growth. Our mission-driven organization is dedicated to making a significant impact in science and healthcare. We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including: Compensation: €65,000 - €83,000 gross annually + performance-based bonus. AI Upskilling: Use up to £10,000 and 10 dedicated days per year for qualified AI-related professional development (AI certification, LLM workshop, or AI bootcamp). Professional Development & Wellbeing: An annual personal development budget of £1,000 for conferences, training, certifications and personal wellbeing. Remote-First Culture: Work from anywhere in Spain with a home-office stipend. Flexible Working: Receive 25 working days of annual leave plus public holidays and flexible hours to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Diverse Team: Join an international and diverse team passionate about transforming healthcare through data. Deep Technology & Science: Get exposure to problems and applications in the cloud, data analysis, ML, life sciences, and big data fields. Join us at Lifebit for a career that promises to be your next significant venture, dedicated to advancing the scientific and healthcare fields. Don't miss the chance to be part of our mission! Life at Lifebit Lifebit is dedicated to fostering an environment where employees can flourish, valuing individual strengths, skills, and passions. We prioritize health and well-being, offering comprehensive benefits and support. Our fully remote model is built on trust and asynchronous communication, utilizing virtual workshops and occasional off-sites to maximize creativity and innovation. Lifebit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. In compliance with the Estatuto de los Trabajadores and Ley 15/2022 guidelines, we ensure transparent pay structures and robust data privacy for all staff. Join us in reshaping the future of data analysis and technology integration.

review_candidates.title: Senior Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
review_candidates.description: About ExpertVision Ai   ExpertVision AI is a Swiss computer vision startup building AI-powered loss prevention for physical retail. Our multi-camera platform detects theft in real time and includes patent-pending, non-biometric customer re-identification technology. We're already running pilots with large retailers and collaborating with top Swiss Universities.   We're a small, fast-moving team solving hard 3D perception and real-time systems problems in live store environments — not just research demos.   About the role We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer to drive the development of advanced real-time perception systems, 3D spatial reconstruction, and video analytics pipeline solutions.   In this role, you will be responsible for building high-performance C++/Python video streams, deploying Deep Learning models optimized on NVIDIA GPUs, implementing 2D/3D human body reconstruction, and developing multi-camera object tracking systems operating over low-latency edge and cloud infrastructures. Key Responsibilities   Real-Time Video Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize high-throughput, low-latency video streaming pipelines using GStreamer , NVIDIA DeepStream , and OpenCV interfacing with RTSP and ONVIF cameras .   3D Perception & Reconstruction: Implement advanced camera calibration techniques, single-view 3D reconstruction algorithms, and 2D/3D human body mesh/pose estimation pipelines.   Tracking & Analytics: Develop robust multi-object and human tracking systems capable of handling occlusions, dynamic lighting, and complex real-world edge cases.   Model Optimization & CUDA Acceleration: Optimize Deep Learning inference workflows (TensorRT/CUDA/C++) to run efficiently at high frame rates with low latency on GPU hardware.   High-Performance System Code: Write clean, highly performant C++ and Python code backed by solid profiling, concurrency, and memory management.   Event-Driven Architecture: Integrate vision telemetry and metadata into asynchronous messaging systems like NATS (or Kafka/RabbitMQ) for downstream processing.   Deployment & Linux Infrastructure: Containerize microservices using Docker and Docker Compose for seamless deployment across production Linux environments.   Technical Skills   Experience: 3–6+ years of professional engineering experience delivering production-grade Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions.   Languages: Advanced proficiency in both Python and C/C++ (modern C++17/20, CUDA C++ integration).   Video Streaming & Acceleration: Hands-on mastery of GStreamer , NVIDIA DeepStream SDK , OpenCV , and NVIDIA CUDA acceleration.   3D & Geometry Vision: Deep expertise in camera calibration (intrinsic/extrinsic), epipolar geometry, single-view 3D reconstruction, and 2D/3D human body/pose estimation (e.g., SMPL, OpenPose, MediaPipe, mesh recovery).   Tracking Algorithms: Demonstrated experience implementing 2D/3D multi-target tracking algorithms (DeepSORT, ByteTrack, Kalman Filters, re-identification models).   Ingestion & Protocols: Experience working directly with IP/Security camera hardware, network protocols ( RTSP , ONVIF ), and hardware video decoders (NVDEC).   Performance Optimization: Demonstrated ability in high-performance computing, code profiling (NVIDIA Nsight, gprof), memory footprint reduction, and throughput optimization.   Messaging & Systems: Experience with message brokers ( NATS , Kafka), containerized deployments ( Docker , Docker Compose ), and operational Linux environments. Nice to Have   Familiarity with TensorRT custom plugin development in CUDA/C++.   Knowledge of edge orchestration or embedded platforms (NVIDIA Jetson AGX/Orin).   Background in synthetic data generation or domain adaptation for vision models.   Location Remote — we're a remote-first team. Occasional travel to our Zurich HQ or team offsites may be expected. We want to hear from candidates based in: Romania or India What we offer Genuinely hard, unsolved problems in 3D perception and real-time tracking — running in live retail stores today, not academic benchmarks. Architectural ownership: as a senior hire, you'll shape the core CV/ML pipeline and set technical direction for the team. Direct collaboration with Swiss Universities. Competitive compensation package for the right individual.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Secrets Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About The Team The Secrets Infrastructure team provides the cryptographic identity and secrets management foundation for Stripe. We build and operate the internal certificate authority that authenticates every person and service at Stripe, and the secrets platform that manages everything from financial partner credentials to infrastructure access keys. We build foundational security infrastructure at scale: our certificate authority issues mTLS client certificate identities for thousands of services and engineers, and our secrets platform and libraries protect access to critical financial systems and external partners across all of Stripe’s codebases, services, and platforms. The technical challenges include building systems with 99.99%+ availability, implementing TLS workload identity and attestation logic for new platforms, and designing secret management tools that are both secure and user-friendly. Our infrastructure must be both reliable and developer-friendly—we maintain libraries in Go, Java, Ruby, and Python. As a small team responsible for critical systems, engineers take on meaningful ownership. Through collaboration with teams across Stripe, you'll build and set direction for the authentication and secrets management underpin identity in distributed systems at scale. Secrets Infrastructure is a fully remote team, with a small presence in the Seattle and New York City offices. We pride ourselves on a friendly, technically rigorous, and supportive team culture. What you'll do You'll be responsible for TLS identity and secrets infrastructure that every Stripe service depends on. You'll build infrastructure, developer tools, and guide partner teams on architecture decisions; we regularly need to help other teams reason about cryptographic primitives and PKI, transitive trust, potential failure modes and threat models. Since our infrastructure and libraries are used across the entire Stripe codebase, you'll work in Go, Java, Ruby, and Python. The services we own are written in Go, so most of your hands-on work will be in Go. The typical balance of hands-on work is about 60% coding, 20% infrastructure work, and 20% security design/guidance with partner teams. Responsibilities Design and implement significant features in our certificate authority and secrets management systems Work across Go, Java, Ruby, and Python to implement authentication and secrets infrastructure used by every service at Stripe Work with with other engineering teams to understand their needs and design secrets and identity integrations Develop certificate provisioning and secret management integrations for various compute platforms (Kubernetes, EC2, developer workstations) Work on reliability improvements to maintain 99.99%+ availability for critical infrastructure; we take pride in making failure modes impossible instead of reacting to them Participate in on-call rotation for critical infrastructure, working alongside senior engineers to debug and resolve production issues Who you are We’re looking for a senior candidate who has enough prior experience in security, backend API development, and infrastructure to quickly take responsibility for significant projects. We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong programming skills in Go, with significant experience in other similar system programming languages (C++, Rust, C#, etc) as a potential alternative. 3+ years of infrastructure and security experience (can overlap with other experience) Experience in cryptography, PKI, secret management, or other security topics Familiarity with infrastructure tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, and cloud platforms Interest in security, infrastructure, and software development Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and working across multiple programming languages Strong debugging and problem-solving skills; the team maintains and troubleshoots integrations across all Stripe languages and infrastructure Clear verbal and written communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with other engineers Experience leading cross-team projects and building alignment on multi-team technical direction Strong technical writing skills to write design documents On-call experience Preferred Qualifications Prior experience building PKI or secret management infrastructure (as an SWE - not just provisioning a 3rd party tool or service) Experience in Java, Ruby, or Python Experience building developer tools, libraries, or platform services Experience with kubernetes internals (how the platform works, not just as a user) Experience operating complex services on AWS Experience in fully remote work environments Working remotely at Stripe A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live. Pay and benefits The annual US base salary range for this role is $173,000 - $259,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our California applicant personal information notice here. The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.
